why: The teacher is what moved (journal, 2026-09-15): cloning search-4 instead of Greedy takes the clone from 32.0% to 71.0% against Greedy and 94.0% to 99.25% against Random, so it is now the strongest agent here that is not a searched weight set, and it clears the commit bar. Run with commit=true to propose it. The value policy went the other way on the same data, 43.5% to 1 win in 400, and it is worth knowing why rather than only that: it plays heavy_strike, basic_attack, pummel and wait -- the starting kit -- because its r2 is -0.3457 against a baselineR2 of 0.0705, and an argmax over 588 keys with no signal is whatever order the noise gives. Sharing its rows by decision kind was measured and lost (ADR 0045): it fits far better and plays 11 points worse, so share stays action. Watch the clone's win rate against Greedy, not any fit. Open: the value policy ranks no better than chance on either dataset, and (kind, spell) sharing is the next thing to try on it.
